payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in macro-average F1-scores and specific relation classifications.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent compared to previous state-of-the-art systems.
The model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for predicting implicit discourse relations.
The model showed clear performance gains of around 2 to 8 percent on specific discourse relations compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
